item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00330","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C21","C09","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C21","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"literal_language_template","rationale":"C21 plausibly supplied material language for the child's central rationale. Both directives address wage stabilization under the Defense Production Act and frame the policy through the relationship between stabilization controls and free collective bargaining. The child reverses C21's predicate—stating that stabilization is no longer necessary and that collective bargaining should again operate freely—but retains its distinctive conceptual and verbal framing. C09 is closely connected to the same wage-control machinery but contributes less distinctive language. C01 contains a somewhat similar preservation-of-liabilities clause, but that is ancillary and more conventional.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the stabilization of wages, salaries, and other compensation is not now necessary to carry out the purposes of the Defense Production Act","parent_excerpt":"the maintenance of wage stabilization under the Defense Production Act of 1950 is essential at this time in the interest of the national defense","explanation":"The child appears to adapt and reverse the parent's distinctive necessity finding concerning wage stabilization under the same statute."},{"child_excerpt":"the earliest possible return to freedom of collective bargaining in the determination of wages","parent_excerpt":"the maintenance of effective wage stabilization imposes limitation on the processes of free collective bargaining","explanation":"Both use free collective bargaining as the counterweight to wage stabilization, with the later directive converting the earlier acknowledged limitation into a reason for suspension."},{"child_excerpt":"adjustments of wages, salaries, and other compensation arrived at through the processes of free collective bargaining or other voluntary action","parent_excerpt":"To the maximum extent consistent with the maintenance of effective economic stabilization, the provisions of this Part shall be administered in such a way as to preserve collective bargaining between labor and management.","explanation":"The later directive carries forward the parent's specific policy pairing of wage stabilization administration and preservation of collective bargaining, while changing the operative policy from accommodation to suspension."}]}
